pages.title: Omnipotent Edge
pages.text: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.

Cuts through any armour and any invulnerability. Use: $(thing)Erasure$() - every hostile creature within 64 blocks of you, seen or not, ceases to exist, and what they drop comes to you as $(item)Folded Matter$(). Sneak-use: $(thing)Chronal Stasis$() - time stops for every creature within 24 blocks for 10 seconds.
